flags.message: The snapshot and document manifest label the petition filing April 15, 2026, but the petition cover and attachment path indicate May 20 and the docketing date is May 29. I retained the supplied snapshot and event without repairing dates; this discrepancy did not drive the forecast. The petition appendix is also truncated according to the manifest.

The provisioned August 17 opposition reports an intervening Wolford decision and dismissal of Maryland's distinct petition No. 25-1206. I used this pre-snapshot companion-case account, with attribution and verification limits, to assess the GVR route in this forward cell. It does not disclose the outcome of target petition No. 25-1324. No target outcome was sought or encountered.
